subject: Adapted evaluation plan + scope consolidation for Tenryu POC
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@tenryu.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-24T16:15:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Tenryu POC — recap, success criteria, next steps

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff:

- Goals we heard: 1) reduce failed routing rate for mid-to-high complexity orders, 2) maintain sub-300ms median inference latency for chat surface, 3) prove cost-per-1k tokens under your target for peak hours.
- Proposed POC scope (initial): order-intent extraction (baseline), customer chat triage (chat UX), embeddings for search.
- Success criteria (draft):
  * Order routing accuracy >= 87% on Tenryu holdout set (near-term),
  * Median latency <= 300ms 95th percentile for 1k tokens,
  * E2E response time under 1.2s for chat sample flows.

Next steps:
1) You to confirm the canonical holdout dataset and provide the sample order logs (S3 link).
2) We to deliver an evaluation plan and timeline by Monday (I’ll include owners).
3) Kickoff: proposed 2027-05-03.

Attachments: none in this email — please send the order logs when convenient.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Zhang <olivia@tenryu.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@tenryu.ai>, salesops@tenryu.ai
Date: 2027-04-24T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Tenryu POC — recap, success criteria, next steps

Thanks Lauren — this looks good. A couple of clarifications/requests from our side:

1) Additional use case: during the call we realized "order routing for returns" is higher priority than embeddings for search. Can you add returns-routing as a discrete use case to the POC? It would use the same intent extraction model but different acceptance thresholds.
2) Success criteria tweak: for the routing use case we want to measure precision at top-1 and reduce manual reroute rate by 20% (not just accuracy).
3) Timeline constraint: our legal/procurement needs a 4-week demo run (not 2 weeks) for compliance. That means the trial/run window should be 4 weeks starting at kickoff.

I've attached a short workbook with sample logs and our prioritized use-case list.

Attachment: tenryu_poc-requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 450KB)

Let me know if adding returns-routing is feasible without pushing kickoff past 05/03.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Zhang
Head of Product, Tenryu Labs
olivia@tenryu.ai

Questions / asks:
- Ben: can the proposed infra/throughput handle an added returns-routing workload without changing dedicated capacity? If not, what delta in cost/latency are we expecting?
- Priyom: can you adjust the eval plan (metrics, datasets, gating) and produce an updated timeline that shows a 4-week run and proposed checkpoints (week 1 ingestion/ingest validation, week 2 baseline vs Redwood, week 3 iterative tuning, week 4 eval + handoff)?
- Marissa: please review SLA/credit ask — Tenryu is likely to push for an uptime/latency SLA for the demo period.

I'm proposing we keep kickoff on 2027-05-03 but push the evaluative window to end 2027-05-31. If capacity/ops requires, we can shift kickoff by one week.

All — quick notes from infra/ops perspective:

- Adding returns-routing is fine; it reuses the intent extraction pipeline and should not require additional model variants. We should budget ~12% more token throughput during peak (based on Tenryu sample logs).
- Latency impact: median should stay within target if we keep batching and KV cache enabled; 95th p95 may increase by ~20ms under peak load.
- Cost delta estimate: incremental reserved capacity delta ~ $1.8k/month prorated; for the 4-week demo we'll propose a one-time demo credit offset instead of changing the customer commitment.

Action owners:
- Priyom: update eval plan and lane tests (I can help with load scenarios). Due EOD Friday 2027-04-28.
- Lauren: confirm kickoff date with Olivia and send updated eval plan + drive link.
- Marissa: I'll flag the potential SLA ask in the deal desk and propose a demo-credit SKU.

Subject: Updated POC plan and timeline (includes returns-routing) — Tenryu

Hi Olivia / Aaron — thanks for the quick reply and for sending the workbook. We've updated the evaluation plan and timeline to incorporate returns-routing and the 4-week demo window. Summary of changes and next steps: 

Scope changes (added):
- Returns-routing: separate test cohort and precision@1 target (target: precision@1 >= 0.88, manual reroute reduction >= 20% vs baseline). This will reuse intent extraction model and the same deployment profile.

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): data ingest + validation (Tenryu provides S3 logs, we validate schema).
- Week 1: baseline collection (measure current routing precision and manual reroute rate).
- Weeks 2–3: tuning & iterative rollouts (A/B toggles, routing heuristics).
- Week 4: final evaluation, handoff docs, and a short performance review session.

SLA / credits:
- We propose a demo-credit of $1,800 to cover incremental reserved capacity for the 4-week window. Marissa will confirm formal credit SKU.

Attachments & links:
- Updated evaluation plan (attached): redwood_adapted-eval-plan.pdf
- Shared folder with test harness and dashboards: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq4-POC-tenryu-eval
- HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4891

Proposed kickoff: 2027-05-03 (no change). Please confirm by EOD Tuesday 2027-04-27 so we can schedule the Week 0 data sync.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Lauren
